title: Stage estimate program
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\tau\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $0<\tau\leq 1$, let $k$ be a natural number with $k<n$, and let $A$ be a finite family of sets of coordinates in $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The stage estimate program uses membership queries to run, in sequence, one candidate estimate program for each frequency prefix selected from $A$ by the candidate rule at coordinate $k$; each program records the coordinate set consisting of the first $k+1$ coordinates and that prefix, and the resulting list of records is returned.
hypotheses_covered: Stage index $k$ is a natural number with $k<n$
Active family $A$ is a finite family of coordinate sets
caveat: The candidate-selection rule and coordinate-prefix convention are referenced but not defined in the supplied definitions.
